items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: You were in the band and Max and Bud Powell and I think Kenny Durham.

ctx.x: Yeah. I remember that night at Birdland. You were in the band and Max and Bud Powell and I think Kenny Durham. And there was that awful business with -- he started yelling for Bud to get on the stand.
That wasn't Max. That was Art Blakey.
